hints.title: Bitmask Character Differences
hints.text: Only dictionary words of the same length as the target need consideration. Use bitmasks where bit i is set if word differs from target at position i.

hints.title: Distinguishing Bit Subsets
hints.text: An abbreviation keeps characters where mask bit is 1. To avoid matching any dictionary word, the retained character mask must share at least one differing position with every dictionary candidate.

hints.title: Abbreviation Length Minimization
hints.text: Search bit subsets with depth search and branch pruning. For each candidate mask, compute its abbreviation length by counting retained letters plus distinct runs of masked zeroes. Choose the valid mask yielding minimum formatted length.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: D: count of words in dictionary
complexity.notes: Bitmask search over M positions with early branch-and-bound pruning.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all abbreviations and string-matching each against dictionary is combinatorial explosion.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Pre-encoding word differences as integer bitmasks speeds conflict testing to single bitwise operations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Model conflicts as bitmasks and optimize abbreviation lengths with branch and bound.
